title: LLM-Based Wget Activity Triage via Auditd
author: Elastic
description:
Detects non-allowlisted wget activity on Linux hosts via Auditd Manager or Auditbeat and uses an LLM to assess whether
the activity is malicious, benign, or requires investigation. The rule parses and normalizes the destination, redacts
sensitive command-line values, and aggregates activity by host and destination before invoking the ES|QL COMPLETION
command. Only true positive or suspicious verdicts with confidence above 0.7 generate alerts.
